title: Admissible subalgebra containing a finite set
statement: Let k be a field of characteristic p > 0, Λ a Noetherian geometrically regular k-algebra [def-weil-pbc-g-ring], q a prime ideal, n ≥ 1, B = Λ_q/(qΛ_q)^n and E a finite subset of B. There exists a local k-subalgebra A of B containing E and Popescu-admissible for qB [def-weil-pbc-popescu-admissible-subalgebra].

proof.text: Apply the localized quotient setup lemma to obtain Artinianity, locality, the maximal-ideal identity and finite residue cotangent homology.
Apply exists_directed_artinian_flat_subalgebras at universes u, v, 0 to the constructed quotient B and retain its directedness, cover and subalgebra properties.

The cover applied to zero makes the family nonempty, including for an empty finite set. Induction on E and directedness put E in a common member. Its Artinian, essentially finite type and flat local properties, together with the maximal-ideal identity from setup, give IsPopescuAdmissible.

theorem exists_popescu_admissible_containing_finset
    (k : Type u) (Λ : Type v) [Field k] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k Λ]
    [IsNoetherianRing Λ] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p)
    (hreg : IsGeometricallyRegular k Λ) (q : Ideal Λ) [q.IsPrime]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (E : Finset (Localization.AtPrime q ⧸
      (q.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q))) ^ n)) :
    ∃ (A : Subalgebra k (Localization.AtPrime q ⧸
        (q.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q))) ^ n)) (_ : IsLocalRing A),
      A.IsPopescuAdmissible ((q.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q))).map
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((q.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q))) ^ n))) ∧
      ∀ e ∈ E, e ∈ A
